html:
Bagrat III was the first king of a united Georgia, ruling the western kingdom of Abkhazia from 978 and adding the eastern lands of Kartli by 1008, until his death in 1014.

He was a prince of the Bagrationi family, which ruled Georgia from then until 1801. His adoptive father David of Tao, a powerful prince in the southwest, helped him gather the Georgian principalities, and he inherited Abkhazia through his mother. He made Kutaisi his capital and built the great Bagrati Cathedral there, finished in 1003. Kakheti and Tbilisi still lay outside his rule, but his work created the Kingdom of Georgia that reached its golden age under David IV and Tamar.
sum: Bagrat III was the first king of a united Georgia, ruling the western kingdom of Abkhazia from 978 and adding the eastern lands of Kartli by 1008, until his death in 1014.
